snippet.title: Kaihan Krippendorff
snippet.description:
Kaihan Krippendorff is the Founder of Outthinker, a global think-tank of chief strategy, innovation, growth, and transformation officers and executives of leadin global companies

He is a 6x author of Outthink the Competition, Driving Innovation from Within, and Proximity, Kaihan is recognized by Thinkers50 and Global Gurus as one of the top 20 global management thinkers in strategy and innovation. 

Known for rigorously researched and practical business tools, Kaihan is a sought-after strategic advisor for some of the world’s most recognizable companies like Aetna-CVS, JP Morgan, Lockheed Martin, Bank of America, Procter & Gamble, IBM, and Yahoo. His work has created in excess of $3.0 billion of new annual recurring revenue.

He hosts Outthinkers, The Chief Strategy Officer Podcast, and Strategy at Scale podcasts; teaches strategy and innovation for Wharton, FIU, and NYU; contributes regularly to Harvard Business Review and Fast Company; and sits on two corporate advisory boards.

snippet.title: Rystad Energy
snippet.description: Rystad Energy is an independent research and intelligence company, dedicated to equipping clients with data, insights and education that power better decision-making. Energy is the lifeblood of our company. Our bottom-up approach starts at the most granular level: we put the pieces together to make sense of the whole picture, create visions for the future and empower the decisions to get there. Our expertise spans energy, climate and the economy, including oil and gas, geopolitics, renewables and clean technologies, supply chains, power markets, and macroeconomics. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Oslo, Norway, we’ve grown to nearly 900 professionals across 31 global offices. Through a foundation of trust, respect and deep expertise, we deliver customer-focused intelligence, advisory services and ongoing support that helps global decision-makers navigate today’s dynamic markets.

snippet.title: Foreign Policy
snippet.description:
Foreign Policy is a global affairs magazine and website. Founded in 1970, its editors set out to create a platform for alternative views about U.S. foreign policy in a way that was “serious but not scholarly, lively but not glib.” Today, FP continues to be serious, lively, and non-partisan but also global and diverse. It is a forum for new ideas and debate on international politics and economics, drawing on a team of in-house reporters as well as writers who are experts or practitioners of foreign policy and based around the world. FP has also grown to include podcasts, live audio and video journalism, research and analytics, and events.

Subscribe to FP’s YouTube channel and visit foreignpolicy.com to experience the magazine.

We're here to simplify complex economic and political theories and expose the hidden forces shaping our world. Through powerful visual essays, narrated explainers, and deep-dive breakdowns, we make ideas from Karl Marx, Adam Smith, John Maynard Keynes, and other great thinkers accessible and relevant.

Whether you're trying to understand capitalism vs. socialism, decode economic systems, or grasp the meaning behind global political events, this channel is for you.

Political economy explained clearly
Capitalism, socialism & mixed economies
Theories from Marx, Smith, Keynes & more
How political ideologies shape economies
The real power behind markets and institutions
Classic books like Das Kapital & The Wealth of Nations

💥 New videos daily! Follow us to think critically and see the world through the lens of political economy.
